INSERT INTO exam_value (record_id, indicator_id, value_decimal, value_text, ref_min, ref_max, ref_text, ref_source, raw_name, raw_unit, is_abnormal) VALUES
(#{item.recordId}, #{item.indicatorId}, #{item.valueDecimal}, #{item.valueText}, #{item.refMin}, #{item.refMax}, #{item.refText}, #{item.refSource}, #{item.rawName}, #{item.rawUnit}, #{item.isAbnormal})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v.indicator_id) FROM exam_value v JOIN exam_record r ON v.record_id = r.id JOIN exam_indicator i ON v.indicator_id = i.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND (i.owner_id = 0 OR i.owner_id = #{userId})

SELECT t.indicator_id AS indicatorId, t.value_decimal AS valueDecimal FROM ( SELECT v.indicator_id, v.value_decimal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY v.indicator_id ORDER BY r.exam_date DESC, v.id DESC) AS rn FROM exam_value v JOIN exam_record r ON r.id = v.record_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND v.value_decimal IS NOT NULL ) t WHERE t.rn = 1

SELECT i.id AS indicatorId, i.name AS indicatorName, i.unit AS unit, i.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, COUNT(v.id) AS recordCount FROM exam_value v JOIN exam_record r ON r.id = v.record_id JOIN exam_indicator i ON i.id = v.indicator_id LEFT JOIN exam_category c ON c.id = i.category_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND v.value_decimal IS NOT NULL AND i.value_type = 'number' AND (i.owner_id = 0 OR i.owner_id = #{userId}) GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.unit, i.category_id, c.name, i.sort_order ORDER BY i.category_id ASC, i.sort_order ASC
